payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

condition.question: Is the source mug visibly positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image?
condition.criteria: Compare SOURCE and EDITED, tracking the single light-blue mug left of the black headphones in SOURCE by visible appearance and context. Judge the requested relative placement of that source mug, not the presence of another mug. Full fulfillment requires evidence that the source mug itself is positioned to the right of the headphones. Partial fulfillment requires concrete visual evidence that the source mug moved toward the right of the headphones but has not reached that position; do not infer movement merely from a blurred remnant or from a different-looking mug on the right. If the edited image does not establish whether a visible mug is the source mug or whether it moved, treat the evidence as insufficient rather than inferring either progress or no progress.
condition.binding: SOURCE: the single light-blue mug left of the black headphones. EDITED: a blue blurred patch appears near the former left-side location, with a white mug left of the headphones and another white mug to their right. Neither white mug is established as the source mug by the supplied visual evidence; do not infer identity or movement from position alone.
condition.source_quote: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
condition.aspect: Relative position and continuity of the source mug and headphones
condition.endpoint: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
condition.necessity: Moving the requested source mug, rather than introducing or repositioning a different mug, is necessary to fulfill the requested relative placement.
condition.zero_when: There is concrete evidence that the source mug did not move toward the right of the headphones, or no requested movement is visible; a different mug on the right or a blue blurred remnant alone does not establish movement.
condition.half_when: Concrete visual evidence identifies the source mug and shows it moved toward the right of the headphones, but it remains short of being positioned to their right, with a visible remaining positional deficiency.
condition.full_when: The source mug is visibly identifiable as the same mug and is positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image.
